description: Store a message, fact, or conversation snippet in the agent's long-term memory. Memory persists across sessions and can be retrieved later via semantic search. Use this to remember important user preferences, decisions, or context.

content.description: The text content to store in memory (a message, fact, or note)

speaker.description: Who said it: "user", "agent", or a person's name (default: "user")

name: store_memory
